description: This Java class 'CodedOrFreeText' defines a data structure used within the OpenMRS framework to represent either a coded concept or free-text input for a concept, typically used to record observations or data points within a healthcare context.

classes.name: CodedOrFreeText
classes.description: A class that encapsulates either a coded concept or free-text description for representing concepts in medical observations.

methods.name: CodedOrFreeText
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to initialize the class with a coded concept, a specific concept name, and a non-coded string.

methods.name: getNonCoded
methods.description: Returns the manually written string name of the concept.

methods.name: setNonCoded
methods.description: Sets the manually written string name of the concept.
